'''Korryn''' was a [[Thalassian/Legends|Thalassian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] who was tasked with supplying [[Arda Base]] with medical supplies. She was the captain of smuggler crew and had two children.

==History==
When Korryn arrived at [[Arda I]], she was recruited for base defense by the [[Ardan resistance]]. During [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|the battle of the Gauntlet]], she provided much needed assistance during the dogfight.<ref name="OAA1" />
